recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast full-body portrait of a woman in black leather leaning against a curved marble pillar, framed by a thin red border and featuring large, gestural hand-drawn script in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a vertical marble texture on the left third
Large gestural script overlapping a smaller, widely-spaced serif subtitle
Thin red border framing the entire composition
Deep shadows in the lower right contrasting with soft lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned on the left vertical axis, leaning against a pillar that occupies the left 30% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large black script in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the lean of the body, then jumps to the large script and follows the underline back toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the middle right, transitioning from a neutral wall to a dark floor.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral beige and off-white (marble and wall)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black leather and the light background.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker
Long horizontal underline extending from the final character
Oversized scale relative to other elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal tail on the final letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale black script paired with a tiny, ultra-spaced red serif for a sophisticated pop-rock contrast.

preserve: Extreme letter-spacing of the secondary text
Red color for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, energetic feel of the 70s signature style.
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body shot of a woman in a black leather jacket and pants leaning against a curved marble pillar on the left. The background is a plain off-white wall with a dark floor. High contrast lighting. Add a thin red border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, black, gestural hand-written script in the upper right. Below it, add a line of all-caps serif text in red with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thin and consistent?
Does the script have a hand-drawn, marker-like quality?
Is the marble texture visible on the left side?
Is the secondary text red and widely spaced?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red border does not overlap the subject.
Check that the script underline is straight but hand-drawn.
Verify the marble texture looks like a physical architectural element.
Confirm the lighting on the subject matches the shadows on the floor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion leather portrait with architectural textures, framed by a minimalist red border and topped with aggressive, oversized marker-style lettering.
